To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have generated 16 microW of continuous-wave coherent radiation near 194 nm by sum-frequency generation inside an enhancement cavity.
we have demonstrated continuous-wave sum-frequency generation of coherent radiation tunable in the 190-195 nm region in beta-BaBO(4) crystals placed inside an external cavity.
continuous-wave sum-frequency generation of coherent radiation near 194 nm was achieved by sum-frequency generation (SFG) in beta-BaBO4 placed inside an external high-finesse enhancement cavity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the generation of continuous-wave coherent radiation in the vacuum ultraviolet (VUV) spectral region near 194 nm.
the development of a new type of tunable, coherent, vacuum-ultraviolet radiation source based on sum-frequency generation in nonlinear optical crystals.
the development of a continuous-wave (CW) sum-frequency generator near 194 nm.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the results of this work demonstrate the feasibility of generating continuous-wave radiation near 194 nm by sum-frequency generation inside an enhancement cavity.

the authors have successfully demonstrated the first CW SFG source near 194 nm. Proc. SPIE 3611, Nonlinear Frequency Generation and Conversion, (15 April 1999); doi: 10.1117/12.346138 Karl K. Wong; James W. Haus, Editor(s)
this is the first demonstration of continuous-wave sum-frequency generation in the deep ultraviolet near 194 nm using a single crystal of beta-Ba(B2O4).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the enhancement cavity technique is a powerful tool to generate coherent radiation at short wavelengths, and it has been demonstrated that the beta-BaB2O4 crystal is a suitable nonlinear medium in this application.
a coherent 193-nm radiation source with a power of a few milliwatts is now within reach.

the output power of sum-frequency generation is proportional to the square of the intensity of the fundamental wave, the square of the length of the nonlinear crystal and the fourth power of the enhancement cavity finesse, but inversely proportional to the square root of the walk-off angle and the fourth power for the walk-off-compensating crystal length.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sum-frequency generation in the ultraviolet can be enhanced using a high-finesse enhancement cavity.
a beta-BaB2O4 crystal can be placed in an enhancement cavity without any significant degradation in the performance.

the output power of sum-frequency generation near the threshold of beta-Ba-B(2)O4 is limited by the absorption of the crystal and the output power can be enhanced by a factor of 100 by placing the crystals inside an external enhancement resonator.
